data.title: Senior Angular Developer (Typescript, UI, English)
data.text:
We are looking for a talented Senior Angular Developer to join our software development team. You will participate in international projects, developing high-quality user interfaces, integrating with backend systems, and ensuring optimal performance for our products. Open for both Fresher and Experienced candidates who are passionate about web technologies and eager to grow in a dynamic and professional environment.

For Fresher-level candidates, we offer a clear training roadmap and hands-on mentorship to help you build strong foundations and grow your career.

1. Technical Skills
Experience:
• Minimum 3–5 years of experience in software development using Angular.
• Hands-on experience in real-world projects utilizing the Angular framework, UI development, and backend API integration.
Frontend Development:
• Proficient in AngularJS/Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and libraries like RxJS, NgRx.
• Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and the MVC pattern.
• Skilled with tools such as Webpack, Angular CLI, and package managers (npm, yarn).
Integration & Development:
• Experience working with RESTful APIs, GraphQL, or similar protocols.
• Familiar with the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including architecture design, unit/integration testing, and CI/CD deployment.
• Ability to design responsive user interfaces and optimize web performance.
Nice-to-Have:
• Experience with other frameworks such as React, React Native, Vue.js, or Node.js.

data.title: Senior Angular Developer (Typescript, UI, English)
data.text:
• Knowledge of microservices, cloud services (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), or backends like .NET, Java, Python.

2. English Skills
• Fluent in English (both spoken and written) to collaborate with international teams and clients.

3. Soft Skills & Responsibilities
Teamwork:
• Work in Agile/Scrum teams alongside Scrum Masters and cross-functional development groups.
• Participate in product design, technical assessments, and code reviews to ensure code quality.
Leadership:
• Capable of leading small teams, mentoring junior/mid-level developers, or acting as a Tech Lead.
• Provide technical solutions, improve development processes, and ensure non-functional requirements are met.
Problem-Solving:
• Strong analytical thinking, system architecture design, and complex issue resolution.
• Research and apply new technologies to enhance project outcomes.

4. Education & Experience
• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields.
• 3–5 years of experience in technology companies, preferably with international or outsourcing environments.

*** Application Requirements
• Detailed CV outlining past experience and completed projects.
• Relevant certifications (if available).

data.company: Công ty Cổ phần Kaopiz Software
data.text:
Mô tả công việc: Phát triển, tối ưu và bảo trì hệ thống web cho khách hàng Nhật Bản với Java (Spring Boot) ở backend & React ở frontend.
Tham gia toàn bộ SDLC: phân tích yêu cầu, thiết kế, coding, code-review, CI/CD và triển khai trên AWS.
Đề xuất giải pháp kỹ thuật, nâng cao hiệu năng (multithread, concurrency), đảm bảo bảo mật và chất lượng mã.
Mentor thành viên junior, phối hợp chặt chẽ với PM và khách hàng.

Yêu cầu ứng viên:
- Học vấn: Tốt nghiệp Đại học chuyên ngành CNTT hoặc liên quan.
- Kinh nghiệm: 4 năm Java/Spring & 2 năm React; từng đảm nhiệm vai trò full-stack.
- Java: OOP, Clean Code, Design Patterns; thuần thục Collection vs Stream, multithread/async; logging; đọc/ghi & migration dữ liệu DynamoDB.
- DynamoDB: phân biệt và dùng đúng Query vs Scan, lấy dữ liệu bulk, thiết kế & sử dụng GSI hiệu quả.
- React: quản lý state toàn cục với useContext hook, hiểu kiến trúc component, tối ưu render.
- AWS: SSH vào EC2, xuất log, phát hiện & xử lý overload/instance die; kiến thức Auto-Scaling, CloudWatch là lợi thế.
- Khác:
- MySQL hoặc NoSQL (MongoDB).
- Thành thạo Git.
- Tư duy giải thuật tốt, tự học nhanh.
- Giao tiếp tiếng Nhật (N3+) là điểm cộng.

Quyền lợi:
- Mức lương khởi điểm hấp dẫn, cạnh tranh, tương xứng với năng lực và kinh nghiệm làm việc.
